description: Mute a member for a set duration (Discord 'timeout'): they cannot send messages, react, or speak until it expires. Pass duration_minutes = 0 to remove an active timeout early. Max 28 days (40320 minutes). Requires the Moderate Members permission.

duration_minutes.description: Timeout length in minutes (0–40320, i.e. up to 28 days). Use 0 to clear an existing timeout.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

user_id.description: Discord user ID (snowflake) of the member to time out.

name: discord_timeout_member
